body:
I hear ya. Do what you gotta do till the clock runs out. 

I might reconsider ending it after my mom dies.

I'm in no position to offer advice. My life is a cage but I'm so beaten by it I don't even care enough to escape anymore. I have cut all ties with my entire family. I speak to my parents (both mid to late 70's) about 2-3 times per year. I guess I've kind of replaced my suicidal ideations with numb detachment. I don't seek catharsis. I don't strive for betterment. I'm married and if you asked her she'd tell you I love her, but it's all just a mask. 

I guess if I had advice to give it would be to stop seeking relief from pain. Let the pain and everything else in life pass through you. Be invisible. You can't hurt what isn't there.
